title: Hodges introduces them to Chick Webb and the band
summary: Hodges brings Chick Webb over, Webb makes them welcome, and Holmes lists the small band's members.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: So anyway, Johnny comes down and he brought Chick with him... He was with Chick Webb's band. He brought Chick over, and he introduced us. "Chick, these boys are from Boston." See, Chick was crazy about Johnny, you know, so naturally, Chick, he's all proud of Johnny and telling us this, that and the other... So he made us feel good, you know; he made us feel right at home. And we met all the rest of the fellows in the band.

Oh, let me see, who was in the band. Amos Truehart, Bobby Starks, what's the name, Slats...trombone player -- yeah, I remember that; it might have been Slats with the brass section. Elmer Williams was the tenor player -- Elmer and Johnny. He just had a small band. And I know the bass player, Leon England... No. It was Leon something, but it wasn't Leon England, because Leon England was the Boss Man.
But yeah, I met all the band. I remember practically
all of them. He made us feel real good. That's when Johnny... When he finished that night, that's when we went to what they call a cutting contest, what they could call a jam session nowadays.
